name: seed-zoo-smoke
comment: Slice J0: the seed-zoo verification (J0-V). Boots an isolated session with a versioned real-bug seed pre-placed (see tests/lanista-seeds/<seed>/seed.json for provenance + placement), waits bootSplash.visible == false FIRST (clicks land 'green' on the occluded tree while the splash owns the screen), then asserts the seed manifest's expectedOnBoot properties. For the founding seed (vault-stale-index-v1): a clean idle boot against this real-bug data proves the app does not hang, wedge, or crash processing the stale index at boot. It does NOT prove e08424b's stale-row re-derivation worked — these assertions are not seed-sensitive (they hold against an empty seed too), because every index-content surface is the Vault face Slice 5 retires. The content-level healed-state assertion is deferred to J1; see tests/lanista-seeds/README.md, 'What the founding journey does NOT prove'. Deliberately does NOT assert Vault shelf-face content (tile identity, group counts): the Vault Browse workstream's Slice 5 retires that face, so this journey stays on boot + non-Vault surfaces only (per the J0 plan's cross-workstream fence). Run with --seed <absolute path to the seed folder> --tag <explicit tag>; the seed's vault/ folder is placed by --seed itself (targets the tagged Roaming AppData root directly as of commit 4ebec25 — see tests/lanista-seeds/README.md).

steps.label: the session answers, drive gated on
one visible window, isolated data root
the boot splash has left the screen (seed loaded without hang)
mark: boot phase complete, asserting expectedOnBoot
expectedOnBoot: the launch-state surface is idle (non-Vault, app initialized cleanly)
